mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for at least 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0), supply chain disruptions intensify, leading to higher input costs and reduced corporate margins, which cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% in a 1-month window, it signals an imminent tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE above 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a stagflationary regime characterized by housing market weakness (HOUST < 1700.0), weak retail sales (RSAFS < 670000.0), and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 290.0), corporate profit margins are squeezed and consumer spending declines, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with reduced manufacturing output and corporate earnings, which depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
